candidates.title: Scrapy CookieJar adapter across Python 3 protocol changes
decision_reasons: The source fix predates the transfer fix and both are natural public repairs.
The pair shares one Python 3 CookieJar adapter boundary but source decoding and transfer protocol-member patches are non-identical.
A dependency-free public extract reproduces the registered source and transfer failures offline, and hidden evaluator coverage is available.

candidates.title: FastAPI request handling across Pydantic field representations
decision_reasons: The source fix predates the transfer fix and both were independently repaired upstream.
Both require reasoning about Pydantic 1.x metadata representations, while source Union classification and transfer concrete-form extraction use non-identical code paths and patches.
Visible and hidden dependency-free tests preserve the upstream failing representation and execute offline.

candidates.title: Pine actions/checkout v4 to v6 workflow replacement
decision_reasons: The tracked evidence records only static reference and YAML checks, not GitHub-hosted Node 24 behavior.
The migration is an identical three-line version replacement and would add a trivial path with no blind behavioral evaluator.

candidates.title: Sanic AsyncioServer parity with Python 3.7
decision_reasons: The tracked record is partial: complete historical suite coverage and older asyncio or uvloop compatibility remain unverified.
The recorded candidate omits the human repair's compatibility behavior, so the current fixture cannot support regression-free blind evaluation.

candidates.title: Keras TFOptimizer named-argument contract
decision_reasons: The historical TensorFlow and Keras dependency stack was not staged and is not reproducible in the bounded offline environment.
No accepted, earlier non-identical source migration was established before freeze.

candidates.title: Ansible resolver with numeric dependency versions
decision_reasons: The task is a configuration-type normalization repair, but no source-before-transfer pair with a shared situated migration principle was verified.
Accepting a transfer-only task would violate the source-transfer design.

candidates.title: Scrapy redirect Location normalization
decision_reasons: The task is a URL-semantics regression and does not depend on dependency or version migration state.
It remains eligible for a future cross-module or misleading-path family, but not S1.
